label: Section
description: A horizontal band of a page that groups rows under an optional heading, such as "Overview" or "Related work". Sections define the page outline: each titled section is a landmark the viewer can jump to and, if collapsible, fold away. Content inside a section is arranged with layout.row and layout.column on a 12-column grid.
usage: Use one section per major part of the page; an untitled first section for the main record body is normal.
Add a description only when the purpose is not obvious from the title.
Make secondary sections (history, related records) collapsible so the main content stays above the fold.
constraints: Parent must be layout.page; children must be layout.row nodes.
title is at most 80 characters; description at most 200.
collapsible requires a title, because the title is the toggle.

description.description: One-line helper text under the title.

binding.description: Structural only; children bind to the page's record.

accessibility.keyboard: Collapsible sections toggle with Enter or Space on the heading button.
accessibility.notes: Titled sections are regions named by their heading (aria-labelledby). Untitled sections render as a plain group, not a landmark. The collapsed state is exposed with aria-expanded.

responsive: Always full page width. Spacing between sections shrinks from space.6 to space.4 below 720px.

examples.description: Collapsible section for related work under the main ticket body
